  Manager Corbi, Tony Georgis, Managing Partner, NewGen Strategies and Solutions,
  LLC, City Administrator Fandino, Public Utilities Assistant General Manager Otto, and
  Deputy City Administrator Kimmey presented the staff report and PowerPoint.

Department:  Finance
Submitted by:  Jessica Alcaraz, Financial Services Administrator

Subject
General Fee Schedule Update for Fiscal Year 2024-25

Recommendation
Receive and file the proposed General Fee Schedule that will be presented to Council for
adoption on April 2, 2024.

Background
The City provides services for a fee to individuals or businesses at an estimated reasonable cost.
The fee calculation considers the cost for efficient and effective delivery of services by City
resources. Fees that do not cover the full cost of service result in a subsidy which may impact
funding and the City’s ability to address various community needs. Some examples of City
services for which customers incur fees include building permits, development permits, and
health and environmental control services.

As part of the annual budget process, the City’s General Fee Schedule is reviewed to ensure
that the fees are set in accordance with applicable federal and state laws. City departments
review fees for services and make recommendations to add and/or delete fees or make changes
to existing fees. In coordination with departments, Finance reviews the changes submitted, and
prepares a draft fee schedule for presentation to the Business Industry Commission (BIC), City
Council, and members of the community.

In accordance with Vernon Municipal Code Section 3.32.080, on June 28, 2023, staff issued a
Request for Proposals (RFP) for a Cost Allocation Plan, Fully-Burdened Staff Hourly Rate and
Master Fee Schedule. Based on an internal panel‘s evaluation, Willdan Financial Services
(Wildan) was recommended for selection in consideration of their expertise, experience and
proposed fees as set forth in the RFP. Wildan’s objective is to perform a study that encompasses
a review and evaluation of user fees for services provided by the City, to allocate overhead and
indirect costs appropriately, and to calculate the cost of providing services. With the completion
of the Wildan study, staff will have a well-documented and transparent cost-of-service analysis
and will prepare an updated General Fee Schedule for City services that accounts for true costs.

Since the Wildan study has not yet been finalized, staff is not recommending any changes to the
FY 2024-25 General Fee Schedule to be proposed for adoption. When available, staff will present
a General Fee Schedule to the BIC, City Council, and members of the public for consideration
and possible adoption for Fiscal Year (FY) 2025-26 that incorporates the calculations derived
from the study.

The proposed General Fee Schedule for FY 2024-25 will be presented as part of a public hearing
that will be held at the April 2, 2024 Council Meeting. As noted above, no fee changes are
proposed for FY 2024-25. Current updates to the Schedule consist of the addition of Fire
Prevention Service Fees (pages 9-16 in Attachment 1). Service costs pertaining to fire prevention
(like certain plan checks, permitting, and inspections) are determined by the Los Angeles County
Fire Department (LACoFire), with such services performed by LACoFire Department personnel.

  Item 2  Page 7 of 28
 Fire Prevention Service Fees have been included in the City’s proposed FY 2024-25 General
Fee Schedule to provide transparency, compiling a comprehensive Schedule that details all of
the fees that may apply when conducting business in the City.

Fiscal Impact
There is no fiscal impact associated with this report.

  VERNON BUSINESS AND INDUSTRY COMMISSION
  SPECIAL MEETING
  THURSDAY, MARCH 14, 2024
  COUNCIL CHAMBER, 4305 SANTA FE AVENUE

  CALL TO ORDER

  Vice Chair Morfin called the meeting to order at 9:03 a.m.

  FLAG SALUTE

  Vice Chair Morfin led the Flag Salute.

  ROLL CALL

  PRESENT:
  Hector Morfin, Vice Chair
  Cathy Browne, Commissioner
  Jack Cline, Commissioner
  Thomas Condon, Commissioner

  ABSENT:
  Duncan Sachdeva, Chair
  Crystal Larios, Commissioner
  Douglas Williams, Commissioner

  STAFF PRESENT:
  Carlos Fandino, City Administrator
  Zaynah Moussa, City Attorney
  Yonnie Parker, Deputy City Clerk
  Jessica Alcaraz, Financial Services Administrator

  APPROVAL OF THE AGENDA

  MOTION
  Commissioner Browne moved and Commissioner Cline seconded a motion to approve
  the agenda. The question was called and the motion carried 4-0, Chair Sachdeva and
  Commissioners Larios and Williams absent.

  Special Business and Industry Commission Meeting Minutes  Page 2 of 3
  March 14, 2024

  PUBLIC COMMENT

  None.

  CONSENT CALENDAR

  MOTION
  Vice Chair Morfin moved and Commissioner Condon seconded a motion to approve
  the Consent Calendar. The question was called and the motion carried 4-0, Chair
  Sachdeva and Commissioners Larios and Williams absent.

  The Consent Calendar consisted of the following item:

  1.  Approval of Minutes
  Recommendation: Approve the August 10, 2023 Regular Business and Industry
  Commission Meeting Minutes.

  NEW BUSINESS

  2.  General Fee Schedule Update for Fiscal Year 2024-25

  Financial Services Administrator Alcaraz presented the staff report.

  In response to Commission questions, Financial Services Administrator Alcaraz
  explained the Los Angeles County Fire Department fee increases.

  MOTION
  Vice Chair Morfin moved and Commissioner Cline seconded a motion to receive and
  file the proposed General Fee Schedule that will be presented to Council for adoption
  on April 2, 2024. The question was called and the motion carried 4-0, Chair Sachdeva
  and Commissioners Larios and Williams absent.

  ORAL REPORTS

  3.  Brief Reports, Announcements, or Directives to Staff

  City Administrator Fandino announced the Vernon CommUNITY Fund Scholarship
  program accepting applications, upcoming Regular City Council Meeting Tuesday,
  March 19, 2024, and Regular Green Vernon Commission Meeting Wednesday, March
  20, 2024.
